title: dryopteris consanguinea
intro: Dryopteris consanguinea, commonly known as the autumn fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris consanguinea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
